verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs list workflows and escalation rules, and Procedures with business logic that act on third-party systems, but the pack has only article titles and taglines with no description of event triggers, conditions, or automatic action execution. Webhooks are outbound event notifications for developers, not rule-to-action automation, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger types, rule/condition definition, the catalog of automated actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Manage Fin AI Agent's escalation guidance and rules
Procedures let you train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish.
